accepted_gaps.rationale: Sheets grid state is canvas-rendered and durable range state is available through /htmlview/sheet. The workflow now compares the exact rectangular region at anchor_cell before/after paste and requires independent sheets.read; DOM-only state projections cannot fetch that model.

The anchored workflow verifies the exact A1-derived rectangle through /htmlview/sheet, but automatic state projections are DOM-only and cannot independently fetch the grid model. Independent sheets.read remains required.

The workflow verifies the exact A1-derived cell value through /htmlview/sheet before/after state. The external projection engine cannot fetch canvas-backed grid state, so sheets.read is the independent verifier.

The raw range paste intentionally consumes the user's already-focused canvas cell. Sheets exposes no DOM identity for the selected canvas cell that a pre-mutation locator can prove. The caller must pass the same anchor_cell identity, and the workflow rejects success unless the complete server-rendered rectangle changes at that exact coordinate.
